name: Spanish Cobras
description: The Insane Spanish Cobras Nation is a primarily Latino (Puerto Rican and Mexican) Folk Nation street gang based on Chicago's North and West sides. Their founding is disputed — a Bridgeport precursor used the Spanish Cobras name by 1960, while the dominant Humboldt Park branch formed in the early 1970s. In 1989, the Cobras, Maniac Latin Disciples, and Two Sixers co-founded Spanish Growth and Development (SGD), modeled on the Chicago Outfit to curb shootings, though it eventually collapsed. The gang has a multi-state presence in Wisconsin, Michigan, Ohio, Connecticut, and Florida.
